_why: forge station dir overlay (station-only; merged over commons map/dirs.json by tools/map/_common.load_map). Rows here only sharpen the role of the lane/work dirs this branch fills (all readme: none, so no generated README changes); `overlay` lists every top-level dir this station's overlay writes into with its role and readme policy, for gen_station_map and orientation. Commons rows for map/ and brain/ (generated READMEs) are not touched.

meta.purpose: Make agents cheaper and better and maintain the kit: tool trials with denominators, code-index/wiki/autoresearch tools, reverse engineering behind a legal gate, new-upstream intake, repin.

repertoire.role: Held lane: permissive upstream method text (ProjectAtlas, evo, openwiki, REA, LibreChat's Pocock skills, pm-ai-shipping), read-only, routed by router/skills.json; index repertoire/INDEX.md (generated).

upstream.role: Ingest records: LOCK/PROVENANCE/RENAMES/PRECEDENCE.json written by tools/upstream/ingest.py.
never_holds: held upstream trees (forge holds none under upstream/)

work.role: Forge outputs, one folder per job: trials, optimize, wiki, re (+ legal_gate.json), arch, repin; plus the checkpoint register.

.claude.role: station rules (rules/station.md), the five gap skills, hooks/station/README.md; workflows arrive with the equip block

brain.role: brain.json (station config) and paper nodes forge-0001..0003

router.role: intents.d/station.json + station.selftest.json, skills.json (seeded; keywords from the intent block)
